evals.prompt: /fix #310 — a null-guard crash in SettingsWindow.xaml.cs. You are on branch feature/settings-toolbar which already has open PR #300, and the PR's changed files include SettingsWindow.xaml.cs. Walk steps 4–8: which branch do you pick, and how does the ship step differ from a fresh-branch run?
evals.expected_output: Step 4 runs gh pr list --state open --head feature/settings-toolbar, finds open PR #300, judges the bug overlaps the PR's changed files so it is PR-blocking, verifies git status --short is clean (or commits only the files the fix touches), stays on feature/settings-toolbar instead of cutting fix/issue-310, captures PRE_FIX_SHA before the fix commit, and at step 8 appends Closes #310 plus the verbatim REVIEW_NOTES to the existing PR #300 body with gh pr edit rather than opening a new PR.

assertions.name: open-pr-detected-before-branching

assertions.name: pr-blocking-judgment

assertions.name: pre-fix-sha-captured

assertions.name: ship-appends-to-existing-pr

evals.prompt: /fix #318 — the issue title is 'Intermittent crash on window open' and the body says 'no deterministic repro, root cause unknown'. Walk the routing decision before any fix work.
evals.expected_output: Step 3 detects hard-bug signals (intermittent, no deterministic repro, root cause unknown) and invokes /diagnosing-bugs before any fix work — it does not jump straight to /tdd. The run then routes on the three outcomes: fix + regression test produced → proceed to branch selection with that fix and test; missing or shallow seam → pause and hand off to the user for /improve-codebase-architecture; no tight red-capable loop → stop and ask for the repro environment, redacted artifacts, or permission to instrument.

assertions.name: hard-bug-signals-detected
assertions.description: The signals intermittent / no deterministic repro / root cause unknown were detected in the title or body before any fix work

assertions.name: diagnosing-bugs-invoked-first
assertions.description: /diagnosing-bugs was invoked before /tdd — the hard-bug path is not patched around with a speculative fix

assertions.name: three-outcome-routing
assertions.description: The run routes on all three /diagnosing-bugs outcomes: fix produced → proceed; shallow seam → user handoff for /improve-codebase-architecture; no red loop → stop and ask for repro artifacts
